description:
Estimate 30-year lump-sum BNG income (LOW/MID/HIGH) for dedicating
`area_ha` hectares of an England parcel to biodiversity net gain habitat
creation, from LandBNG planning assumptions per habitat capped at the
Defra statutory credit price; local factors (flood zone, SSSI, Green Belt,
Ancient Woodland, AONB, Agricultural Land Class, nearby NSIP projects and
how many fall under mandatory BNG) are listed, not priced. England only.
Free, no key.
name: estimate_bng_income
title: Estimate BNG income
